description: This class provides utility methods for storing and retrieving locale settings from the database, specifically managing user properties for locale preferences and global system locale configurations within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: FilterUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing locale preferences in the OpenMRS database, allowing retrieval and storage of locale settings related to user properties and global system properties.

methods.name: restoreLocale
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the user's preferred locale; if unavailable, falls back to system default locale, or a hardcoded default if none is set.

methods.name: readSystemDefaultLocale
methods.description: Fetches the system-wide default locale from global properties, using a provided database connection or establishing a new one.

methods.name: storeLocale
methods.description: Stores a specified locale as both the admin user's property and the system default global property.

methods.name: getUserIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID for a given username or system ID using a provided database connection.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a global property directly from the database, useful during application startup or before context initialization.
